output.prepared_action: Do not click, pay or reply. Mark as phishing and delete.

rules.condition: asks for a password, card number or bank login, OR payment link on an unverified domain

zetaris_queries: SELECT sender_domain, organisation, category, verified FROM osef.senders WHERE sender_domain = 'free.fr'
SELECT rule_id, item_type, condition, decision, rationale FROM osef.rules WHERE item_type IN ('invoice', 'any')

agents.name: Intake
agents.role: Structures the item and screens it for prompt injection

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Reads senders, rules and profile through Zetaris and evaluates the rules

agents.name: MemoryKeeper
agents.role: Recalls the owner's past corrections from Meterless H-MEM

agents.name: Decider
agents.role: Proposes a decision with citations (Nemotron via Nightshift, deep lane)

agents.name: Critic
agents.role: Hard checks plus a 9-point rubric; sends weak proposals back (judge lane)

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Returns the decision, the prepared action and the evidence
